dict.string: Kikiyaku captures system audio to transcribe sound from other apps (such as remote participants in online meetings). It does not capture the screen.
Kikiyaku uses the local network to connect to a translation server (such as LM Studio) running on another device.
Kikiyaku uses the microphone to transcribe and translate meeting audio.

Kikiyaku transcribes meeting audio with on-device speech recognition. When translation is enabled, the recognized text is sent to the translation backend you selected (Anthropic, OpenAI, or a server you configure). The audio itself is never sent.
